title: Group Policy or Microsoft Intune: Managing Devices On-Premises vs From the Cloud
excerpt: Group Policy has managed domain-joined Windows PCs for decades; Intune manages devices wherever they are. This comparison helps decide which to use, or how to split the work between them.
verdict: Group Policy remains a sensible, cost-free choice for a purely on-premises Windows estate where devices stay on the corporate network. Intune becomes essential once you have remote workers, devices that rarely connect to the office, or macOS, iOS and Android to manage. Many organisations run both during a gradual move to cloud management.
